header.description: What: U1 (CP-1) - one Rifleman (Friend) advances on test-town toward (325,300) on CombatPosture, about 74 m from one armed Armed Hostile who stands still. Shows the utility posture decision reacting to health; the check script lowers and restores the Rifleman's Health over HTTP (nothing changes on its own). Judge: (1) healthy and armed against a matched enemy he fights (Suppress); (2) hurt (40 HP) and near death (10 HP) he picks a defensive posture (TakeCover or Flee); (3) healed to 100 HP he goes back to fighting (Suppress or AdvanceAndAttack); (4) with Health held the winner never flips back A->B->A. Fail: Healthy man defends, hurt man keeps fighting, or the posture flickers. Check: python3 scripts/utility-demo-check.py --launch ua-posture
